correctness.rationale: Every nonzero product preserves union of supports; saturation forces exactly coordinate-subset submonoids. Each has group completion the direct product of its periods; the orbital stabilizer axiom identifies the stabilizer as the preimage of a subgroup. The converse is proved by multiplying by a common high multiple of every period to identify eventually periodic residues, confirming the quotient. The cited general K-theory splitting and degree-one stable Hurewicz are applicable. Gaussian coefficient counts yield exact multiplicities; a quantitative top-layer estimate and dominated convergence yield the even/odd theta constants. The standalone checker independently enumerates exact orbital pair sets in six small examples, not as a substitute for proof.
